title: Decision
description: The gate's deterministic verdict on one proposal, with the policy version and state versions it was based on, so it can be reproduced.

outcome.description: ALLOW executes; DENY never does; NEEDS_APPROVAL waits for humans.

reasons.description: Why; at least one unless the outcome is ALLOW.

approvals_required.description: Distinct approvals still needed: 0 for ALLOW/DENY, 1-2 for NEEDS_APPROVAL (rule APPROVALS_MISMATCH).

policy_version.description: Version of the policy set that decided.

autonomy.description: Autonomy level of the action at decision time.

state_versions.description: Version of every state entity read, entity key to version.

proposal_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical proposal; approvals sign this exact hash.
